title: Engineering AI Transformation Platform | Faros

hero.headline: Turn AI potential into proven velocity.
hero.subhead: From pilot to enterprise rollout, confidently accelerate AI rollouts. Faros measures the productivity impact and ROI of AI coding tools.

sections.heading: How we help
sections.body: Measure impact and ROI, accelerate adoption with cross-SDLC visibility, stay in control with governance and guardrails.

sections.heading: Adoption
sections.body: Pilot, learn, scale with a step-by-step framework; power-user and dormant-license identification; cohort comparisons and A/B tests; weekly executive summaries.

sections.heading: ROI
sections.body: Capture true ROI signals with precision analytics and causal analysis; identify best coding assistant/model; share a CFO-ready report.

sections.heading: Visibility
sections.body: Track AI's impact on code quality, security, developer satisfaction, and tech debt — not just velocity; administer surveys.

sections.heading: Impact
sections.body: Pinpoint what's helping and what's holding you back; detect where AI underperforms; alerts when gains stall or decline.

sections.heading: Governance
sections.body: Enforce safety and quality in the IDE; flag PRs needing extra scrutiny; real-time code-quality checks; distinguish human vs. machine-generated code; enforce guardrails at scale.
named_capabilities: Audit trails for AI regulatory compliance

sections.heading: Coverage highlights / metrics
sections.body: Adoption (% AI-generated code by repo/PR, license utilization), pilots (A/B, PR merge rates, code smells, test coverage), rollout (cycle times, CFR, bugs, incidents), governance (AI code tagging, policy orchestration, audit trails).

notes: Governance section names several capabilities the seed tree marks 'partial/roadmap' under Govern (policy orchestration, guardrails at scale, audit trails) and presents them as live product surfaces — propose as faros nodes but keep honesty 'inference' where the page only describes a dashboard/flag rather than an enforcement mechanism. 'Distinguish human vs machine code' and 'AI-generated code tagging' are concrete and read as shipped. Testimonial: Diego Tartara, CTO, Globant. GAINS is a named framework (quarterly AI maturity assessment + 90-day plan).
